_meta.notes: Digitally signed, as flagged: 'Digitally signed by Sim Gill / Date: 2022.01.31 11:21:05 -07'00'' beside a black bar; handwritten Date cell 1/31/22; clerk stamp 'RECEIVED JAN 3 1 2022'. Cover address, phone and email redacted at source. The document AGREES with the chunk file on every field (Sim Gill / District Attorney / Year-End Jan 31 / 2022-01-31 / form_year 2021). SHAPE: attachment-behind-stub on both sides - the county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p6) pages are present, each typed 'See Attached' with an EMPTY page-subtotal cell and a filled grand-total cell; the filer's spreadsheets (p4-p5, p7) carry the lines. PAGE COUNT IS COMPLETE: the form's page-of-9 boxes read 1,2,3 / 6 / 8,9 on physical pages 1,2,3,6,8,9 and the three unnumbered attachment sheets occupy physical 4,5,7 - 9 numbered pages over 9 physical pages, nothing missing. (Contrast the same filer's 2020 filing, key d9da3085, where form page 5 of 7 IS absent.) The two Other-Campaign-Accounts itemized pages are present, typed 'NONE', each printing a grand total of $ 0.00; they are a DIFFERENT table from Schedule A/B and are NOT merged into the sides below. ⚠ PAGES 4 AND 5 ARE STORED ROTATED 90 degrees; they were rotated with PIL (rotate(-90)) for the escalation crops and the emitted `pct:` boxes are converted BACK to the portrait frame poppler renders, so each contribution row is a narrow VERTICAL strip. THE ATTACHMENT SPLITS THE OCCUPATION FIELD IN TWO ('Occupation' and 'Employer' columns where the county grid prints one 'Occupation/Employer' cell), so `occupation` carries both verbatim joined by ' / ' - that separator is this record's convention, not ink on the page; where the filer left the Employer cell empty the field holds the Occupation alone and the row note says the cell was left empty. PRIVACY: Address / City / State / Zip are four separate columns and ONE black bar spans all four on every row of both pages, so donor_city and donor_state are blank with 'redacted at source' on all 80 rows - no geography survives. TWO ORGANIZATION NAMES RUN UNDER THAT BAR and are recorded CLIPPED at the last legible glyph, low confidence + needs_review (lines 50 and 68); three further cells are clipped by their own COLUMN WIDTH (lines 21, 42, 74) and are likewise recorded exactly as printed. The filer lists ORGANIZATIONS in the First Name column with Last Name empty (20 of the 80 rows); donor_raw carries the organization name as printed. Schedule B includes six donations to OTHER candidate committees (Chris Wharton For SLC, Darin Mano for City Council, Angel Vice for City Council, Vote Blake Perez, Thom for Millcreek Council, Utah County Dems) and one to Salt Lake County Democrats - recorded verbatim as recipients.

contributions.detail: 80 attachment rows over two pages sum to 105,071.14 = the attachment's own printed grand total ('Total Contributions $105,071.14', foot of p5) = the county Schedule A stub's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED $105,071.14 (p3) = Summary line 1 Column A. Per-page: p4 41 rows = 48,607.95, p5 39 rows = 56,463.19. NOTE THE SCOPE SPLIT: Column B (Aggregate) is $117,649.54, which is exactly this period's 105,071.14 PLUS the prior year-end filing's 12,578.40 - so Column B is cumulative and Column A is the period; the rows are a period figure and Column A is the correct anchor.

expenditures.detail: 40 attachment rows sum to 20,534.54 = the attachment's printed grand total ('Total Expenses - Period Ending 12/31/21  $20,534.54') = the Schedule B stub's printed TOTAL $20,534.54 (p6) = Summary line 2 COLUMN A. Column B is $26,863.20 = 20,534.54 + the prior filing's cumulative 6,328.66, cumulative and NOT the anchor.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO per-page SUBTOTAL exists on either side: both county stubs (p3, p6) print SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and leave it BLANK, and the attachments print no page subtotals - only one grand total at the foot of the last sheet. The usable gates are the attachment grand totals, and both close exactly. ALSO NOTE: the contributions attachment prints NO subtotal on p4, so p4's 48,607.95 is gated only jointly with p5 against the 105,071.14 grand total.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 and p5 each: Date/First/Last band 600 dpi x2 (left+right halves, PIL rotate(-90)) and Occupation/Employer band 600 dpi x2 = 8 crops. Every name and occupation read identically to the 200 dpi full page; the two clipped organization names and the three column-width-clipped cells were identified at 600 dpi and are recorded as printed, never completed. The 120 amounts were NOT re-cropped: the row sums close to the cent against three independent printed anchors on each side, and per GOTCHAS the document's own arithmetic outranks a glyph re-read - an 80-row and a 40-row exact close cannot survive a misread digit.
